title: Python: Fibonacci Sequence
description: Write a Python function that generates the Fibonacci sequence up to n terms.

codeTemplate.py:
def fibonacci(n):
    fib = [0, 1]
    for i in range(2, n):
        fib.append(fib[i-1] + fib[i-2])
    return fib[:n]

result = fibonacci(10)
print(f"First 10 Fibonacci numbers: {result}")
print(f"Sum: {sum(result)}")

hints: Start with the first two terms: 0 and 1
Each subsequent term is the sum of the two preceding terms
Slice the result to get exactly n terms
